group_assessment.weighting: A narrative review of NRG1-ErbB4 signalling in cortical interneurons and a proposed (not tested) gene-therapy model for adult schizophrenia and ADHD. The system is cortical local circuits in mouse, not developmental epilepsy. WWOX does not appear. It is read for what ErbB4 does in interneurons and dopamine axons and for the direction of the proposed therapeutic manipulation, which is to reduce, not raise, ErbB4 signalling in PV+ cells.

entries.proposition: The review develops a gene-therapy model for adults with schizophrenia that has not been tested.
entries.snippet: Finally, we develop a model for treating adults with Sz via gene therapies targeting NRG1/ErbB4 signaling in local circuit interneurons.

entries.proposition: ErbB4 is found predominantly in interneurons and also in dopamine neuron axons and oligodendrocytes in cortex and hippocampus.
entries.snippet: ErbB4 receptors are predominantly expressed in interneurons, but also present in axonal projections of dopamine (DA) neurons as well as in oligodendrocytes

entries.proposition: The NRG1 EGF-like domain peptide is reported to stimulate activity-dependent GABA release, with effects hinging on ErbB4 in PV+ neurons.
entries.snippet: a recombinant peptide corresponding to the EGF-like domain of NRG1 stimulates activity-dependent release of the inhibitory transmitter GABA

entries.proposition: The peptide is also reported to suppress seizure activity and long-term potentiation.
entries.snippet: The ability of the EGF-like domain peptide to suppress seizure activity and long-term synaptic potentiation (LTP) also implicates NRG1 in homeostatic mechanisms controlling excitatory and inhibitory (E/I) balance in neural circuits

entries.proposition: Dopamine neuron-specific ErbB4 knockout mice show a working-memory phenotype.
entries.snippet: Studies with DA neuron-specific ErbB4 knockout mice indicate that dopaminergic expression of this NRG1 receptor is important for working memory

entries.proposition: Reduced ErbB4 signalling in PV+ cells is proposed to reopen plasticity in adults, i.e. the proposed therapeutic direction is inhibition of ErbB4 in PV+ cells.
entries.snippet: functional recovery of cortical plasticity in adults can be achieved by blocking NRG1 stimulation of ErbB4 receptors in PV+ neurons

entries.proposition: Results on ErbB4 knockout and attention are inconsistent between groups.
entries.snippet: another group reported no deficits in the performance of the ErbB4 constitutive knockout mice (heart rescued) on the 5-CSRTT relative to controls

entries.proposition: NRG1 gene variants do not meet genome-wide significance for schizophrenia risk.
entries.snippet: none meet genome wide significance for conferring an increased risk for the disorder

entries.proposition: The authors state that there is no clinical-trial data on stereotactic injection feasibility for psychiatric illness.
entries.snippet: Another concern is the absence of clinical trial data on the feasibility of stereotactic injection into brain of patients with Sz or other type of psychiatric illness.
